4.302 Uplink Port
Definition
A Uplink Port is a port of an automotive Ethernet switch which is connected to
another Ethernet automotive switch (cascaded switch). A Uplink Port could either
be an internal port or an external port. One Uplink Port is connected to another
Uplink Port. The Uplink Port has a special role from the perspective of the
software.
